http_cookie
Description
Specifies the value in the
Cookie:
header for the specified cookie
name. This is a BIG-IP version 4.X variable, provided for
backward-compatibility. You can use the equivalent 9.X command
HTTP::cookie
instead
Syntax
http_cookie
<
cookie_name
>
http_cookie <cookie_name>
Specifies the value in the
Cookie:
header for the specified
cookie name.
